name: HUNAN RESUN Co., Ltd.
summary: HUNAN RESUN Co., Ltd. specializes in the development, production, and distribution of cleaning agents and surface-active chemicals within China. The company's product range includes laundry powders, liquid cleaning solutions, various bar soaps, dental hygiene products like toothpaste, and specialized cleaning supplies for the hospitality sector. Beyond its domestic activities, the firm exports its merchandise to approximately 50 countries and regions worldwide. This entity was established in 1956 and has its main headquarters situated in Changsha, China.
